attention_label: 热点关注度 · 来源覆盖初榜
attention_method: 按媒体机构数、合并后的讨论或事件数、媒体报道覆盖天数依次降序，完全相同则并列。11月15日至20日的新增材料依据原站稿件核对，署名报道和实质技术分析计入媒体覆盖。同稿分发、二手编译、厂商内容及含赞助披露的采访作为背景呈现。

limitations: 固定资料快照，统计以媒体稿件的原站发布日期为准。对较早事件的本周解读仍可计报道覆盖。
热点榜统计本期选入的独立事件与讨论，允许收录尚无正式技术专题的进展。技术重要性榜沿用六个已评价方向。

weekly_story.question: 从光刻材料到服务器，怎样判断进展离量产还有多远？
weekly_story.overview: TECH+ 报道 JSR 韩国 EUV 光刻胶工厂已竣工。THE ELEC 跟进了 PFN 推理芯片的 3D 堆叠流片计划，ServeTheHome 则在 SC26 拍到了搭载下一代 Xeon 封装的液冷刀片。三条消息分别给出了材料供货、芯片制造和系统集成的阶段线索。
weekly_story.research_question: 后续可核对光刻胶批次一致性和客户验证、DRAM 与逻辑堆叠后的带宽和温度，以及刀片长时间满载时的冷却与整机功耗。

weekly_highlights.reading_question: 光刻胶工厂竣工后，何时能稳定供货？
weekly_highlights.what_happened: JSR 在说明会确认韩国金属氧化物光刻胶工厂已竣工。TECH+ 报道称，JSR 计划于 2027 年初启动量产。
weekly_highlights.why_it_matters: 这是面向 EUV 工艺的材料供给进展。客户使用前还要验证不同批次是否稳定，以及材料与各自产线的曝光和后续工艺是否匹配。
weekly_highlights.evidence_stage: 企业确认厂房竣工。投产时间是计划，合格供货待披露。
weekly_highlights.watch_next: 看客户验证、批次一致性及稳定出货的公开记录。

weekly_highlights.reading_question: 把 DRAM 叠到逻辑裸片上，什么时候能看到实测？
weekly_highlights.what_happened: PFN 与 SEMIFIVE 公布 MN-Core L2000 联合开发方案，将 DRAM 垂直堆叠到逻辑裸片上。THE ELEC 跟进了方案，thebell 采访了 SEMIFIVE 负责人。计划于 2027 年第一季度提交流片。
weekly_highlights.why_it_matters: 缩短存储连接提供了增加带宽的路径，也让供电、热和堆叠良率成为同一设计问题。
weekly_highlights.evidence_stage: 方案已公开，流片和带宽属于企业计划与目标。
weekly_highlights.watch_next: 看样片是否如期产出，以及相同推理负载下的有效带宽、功耗和温度。

weekly_highlights.reading_question: 展会上的液冷刀片，能看到哪些实物证据？
weekly_highlights.what_happened: ServeTheHome 在 SC26 拍到 Bull 的刀片样机，可看到英特尔 Diamond Rapids 封装、双路节点及液冷接头的布局。
weekly_highlights.why_it_matters: 实物照片让人看到服务器如何安排处理器、内存和冷却部件。可用性还需看实际运行条件下的温度与维护数据。
weekly_highlights.evidence_stage: 记者现场见到实物，照片能确认部件布局。
weekly_highlights.watch_next: 看整机交付、持续负载测试和现场维护表现。

article_briefs.reading_question: 把 800V 直流引到机柜边，能否减少供电损耗？
article_briefs.what_happened: 台达电子日本公司与罗姆签署基本协议，准备共同明确 AI 数据中心 800V 直流供电的系统需求。TECH+ 报道解释了高功率机柜的配电与电压转换。
article_briefs.why_it_matters: 提高配电电压会改变配线和转换环节的负担，也给功率半导体的选型带来新的约束。这条进展给「AI 芯片供电与散热」候选专题增加了机柜层面的案例。
article_briefs.evidence_stage: 双方已签署基本协议。系统实测与部署结果待公布。
article_briefs.watch_next: 看试点负载下的端到端效率、散热和可靠性。

article_briefs.reading_question: 微软选定 EMIB 后，先进封装离交付还有多远？
article_briefs.what_happened: 微软和英特尔公布长期合作，计划为 Azure 自研芯片采用 EMIB。Tom’s Hardware 核对了披露范围，芯片型号、晶圆工艺及部署日期仍待公布。
article_briefs.why_it_matters: 云服务商公开表态采用封装方案，使芯粒互连有了可以跟踪的客户案例。能否按时交付，还要看具体器件、验证与封装产能。
article_briefs.evidence_stage: 双方公布采用计划。具体产品与交付规模待披露。
article_briefs.watch_next: 看首个采用该封装的器件、封装测试及交付进度。

article_briefs.reading_question: 集群里的光互连，能省电也能好维护吗？
article_briefs.what_happened: Lambda 披露在加拿大魁北克园区用 NVIDIA 共封装光学交换机连接逾一万张 Blackwell Ultra GPU，ServeTheHome 和 TechTarget 均报道了这次部署。
article_briefs.why_it_matters: 共封装光学进入实际交换网络。评估重点从光器件本身延伸到整网功耗、故障率与现场维修。
article_briefs.evidence_stage: 部署方披露，另有独立媒体报道
article_briefs.watch_next: 看其他客户能否复现，以及整网功耗是否包含光源和控制开销。

article_briefs.reading_question: 同一个封装里，算力芯粒和存储可以怎么接？
article_briefs.what_happened: UCIe 联盟发布 4.0 版芯粒互连规范，增加了用于封装内存储连接的 UCIe.mem。Jon Peddie Research 随后分析了协议变化和系统设计影响。
article_briefs.why_it_matters: UCIe.mem 给封装内存储连接提供了开放接口，影响 SoC 与存储逻辑裸片的组合方式。
article_briefs.evidence_stage: 联盟发布规范，本期有专业媒体解读
article_briefs.watch_next: 看不同厂商器件能否在参考板上互操作，以及整套系统的测试和验证结果。

article_briefs.reading_question: 推理时，能少在存储和计算单元之间搬几次数据吗？
article_briefs.what_happened: Axelera AI 公布面向数据中心推理的 Titania 芯粒架构。在其披露的设计中，数字存内计算、LPDDR6 和可编程 RISC-V 计算集成在同一封装。
article_briefs.why_it_matters: Titania 将数字存内计算用于面向机房的推理芯粒，提供了一条减少数据搬运的设计路线。
article_briefs.evidence_stage: 产品架构披露与媒体分析
article_briefs.watch_next: 看相同模型与精度下的整机能耗、吞吐和软件适配。

technologies.name: LLM辅助RTL生成与验证
technologies.tagline: 从生成代码走向工具反馈与可验证质量

overview.text: 让模型生成或修复RTL，再用仿真、综合及验证工具检查结果，目标是减少设计迭代中的人工工作。现有资料同时涉及生成、验证环境与评测方法。

assessment.text: 建议优先跟进工具反馈闭环与评测可信度。AutoC2V摘要描述综合反馈训练，RTLRepairBench提示评分语义会改变结论；因此价值应结合功能、PPA和工具预算判断。当前材料支持这一研究路径，尚不能证明可自主完成生产级芯片设计。 新增厂商访谈强调由工程师检查结果、根据反馈迭代。相关展会预告也提及硬件辅助验证。两项材料仅支持继续跟踪工具链，当前评分仍主要依据已有研究与可复核评测。

limitations.text: 重置与首周期语义、测试覆盖以及规格使用方式均可能影响通过率。只看一次编译或一个总分不足以评价可靠性；本版未阅读全文或复现实验。

watch_next.text: 观察是否公开工具链、测试语义、失败案例与等预算基线，以及生成后验证和PPA能否同时改善。

technologies.name: AI辅助模拟与RF电路设计
technologies.tagline: 把电路理解与仿真反馈接到优化过程

overview.text: 利用模型理解电路拓扑、生成网表或调整尺寸，并借助仿真反馈搜索满足规格的设计。SAFTAC与TopoSizing分别提供训练反馈和拓扑理解的研究线索。

assessment.text: 值得跟进的重点是模型是否理解电路约束，以及仿真反馈能否减少无效搜索。两个摘要给出不同的实现路径，适合对照研究；厂商方案与研讨会则说明这一方向正在被产品化讨论，但不作为效果认证。 新增 ChipNexus 访谈提供了工具接入与人工评估的工程线索。下一步优先核对跨工艺结果和仿真误差，再判断影响范围。

limitations.text: 摘要中的收益依赖电路类型、工艺及仿真设置；没有证据表明可直接跨工艺、跨拓扑复用。规格满足也不自动等于版图后或硅上可用。

technologies.name: 面向AI的存内与近存计算
technologies.tagline: 减少数据搬运，同时处理精度与可编程性

overview.text: 将部分运算放到存储阵列内部或存储附近，以降低AI任务的数据搬运负担。这里同时跟踪数字近存架构和模拟存内阵列，两者的精度、工艺和软件条件不同。

assessment.text: 其重要性来自存储与计算间的数据搬运限制。近期材料包含近存推理讨论、产品流片报道和温度鲁棒性研究，表明必须把架构、器件及软件一起考虑；流片报道中的性能预测不能当作实测提升。 Titania 后续报道把数字存内计算的适用场景扩展到机房推理。Raptor 采访提供另一条堆叠 DRAM 路线线索，两者都需要统一负载下的端到端比较。

limitations.text: 模拟路线存在温漂与精度约束，近存路线仍受负载映射和软件支持限制；跨论文的TOPS/W或时延不能直接混排。现有材料没有提供统一的独立系统复测。

watch_next.text: 优先观察真实模型的端到端能耗、精度与吞吐，非理想因素补偿的成本，以及可运行的软件接口。

scores.text: 直接面向AI计算的数据搬运与存储墙，具有改变运算位置的潜力。
scores.label: 瓶颈价值

scores.text: 覆盖边缘到机房推理的设计目标，实际影响范围受负载、精度和软件支持约束，初评4。
scores.label: 影响范围

scores.text: 可牵引器件、架构及映射软件协同，但尚未形成统一成熟接口。
scores.label: 带动作用

technologies.maturity: 已有原型，也有产品披露和架构计划。Titania、Raptor 的材料以路线介绍为主，缺少同负载下的独立性能对照。
technologies.evidence_status: 论文摘要、产品披露与采访覆盖不同层级。性能比较需要对齐负载、精度和系统边界。

technologies.name: HBM与AI存储层次协同
technologies.tagline: 在带宽、容量、供电与热约束间协同设计

overview.text: 围绕AI工作负载设计高带宽存储层次，关注控制器分区、存储堆叠与计算侧的协同。相比只追求带宽，容量利用和热设计同样需要评估。

assessment.text: 应把HBM视为存储、互连、供电和软件共同约束的问题。库内材料讨论控制功能迁移、DRAM-on-GPU热设计与字节效率，适合形成系统评价；企业博客提供方法线索，不能替代中立比较。 本周光内存池与封装内存储链路提供了扩充容量的不同路径。评估应区分片上 HBM、CXL 扩容和远端共享的带宽、延迟与用途。美光 3D DRAM 时间表属于企业展望。 THE ELEC 另报道三星在 HBM5 上探索先分别制造存储和外围逻辑晶圆、再键合的路线。该消息来自产业人士，设计细节和量产时间待三星公开确认。

limitations.text: 3D堆叠可能改变热设计和供电条件。NMC-HBM摘要给出电气与系统仿真框架，未证明所有工作负载受益，也不能据此认定已有规模化部署。

watch_next.text: 跟进同负载下的有效带宽、容量利用、系统能耗及温度，核查控制器迁移收益是否覆盖新增复杂度。 PFN 的方案将 DRAM 叠在逻辑裸片上，可作为不同存储集成路线的对照。优先比较样片的有效带宽、功耗和温度。

scores.text: 长上下文和并发使存储压力变化，带宽之外的容量与系统约束具有共性。
scores.label: 瓶颈价值

scores.text: 片上高带宽、封装内连接和机架级内存扩容都影响系统设计。AI 存储研发投入与制造转化成本进一步支持影响范围5分。
scores.label: 影响范围

scores.text: 控制器、堆叠及软件协同能带动多环节改进，但当前例证较局部。
scores.label: 带动作用

technologies.maturity: HBM 有既有商用平台。所列光内存池及 3D DRAM 路线处于开发或路线讨论阶段
technologies.evidence_status: 材料包含公开规范、产业报道和厂商路线。不同存储方案的带宽、延迟和容量口径分别理解。

technologies.name: 面向AI的芯粒与3D集成
technologies.tagline: 扩展系统能力，也把难题带到封装与协同层

overview.text: 通过多个芯粒、中介层或3D堆叠构建AI系统，技术评价需同时考虑接口、原型验证、热与供电。机构平台进展与工程观点提供了不同层次的线索。

assessment.text: 价值在于将计算和存储扩展问题转化为可协同设计的系统问题。imec公告关注中介层及PDK，行业材料讨论多芯粒扩展边界；这支持持续跟踪平台开放性和工程可组合性，而非仅用芯粒数量判断先进程度。 UCIe 4.0 将规范覆盖延伸到封装内存储连接。Titania 提供了专用推理芯粒的设计示例，现阶段可据此跟踪验证板、跨厂商互操作和系统签核。 微软为 Azure 自研芯片公开提出采用 EMIB 的计划，增加了可以跟踪的客户案例。芯片型号、晶圆工艺和实际交付时间待披露。

limitations.text: 更多芯粒并不自动带来更高系统效率，工具速度、共享资源和热设计都可能成为限制。当前公告与讨论不足以验证跨厂商即插即用或量产良率。

watch_next.text: 跟进开放PDK、系统原型、跨芯粒接口与热验证，并在相同负载下比较系统收益和集成代价。 新收录的 PFN 项目提供了可跟踪的流片时间。车载 ACIR 文件则提供了不同厂商芯粒组合时的错误报告、启动和供电管理要求，可作为系统验证的对照。

scores.text: 针对AI系统扩展和集成约束，当前资料以平台与局部验证为主。
scores.label: 瓶颈价值

scores.text: 同时涉及计算、存储、接口、封装与工具协同，有广泛系统影响潜力。
scores.label: 影响范围

scores.text: 开放中介层、PDK 和 UCIe.mem 形成可复用的技术基础，带动作用评为5。跨厂商器件组合和量产验证仍需实证。
scores.label: 带动作用

technologies.maturity: 已有开放标准、机构平台和厂商设计。本版材料未提供跨厂商量产互操作的测试结果。
technologies.evidence_status: 标准文件和机构公告说明接口要求，报道与厂商披露说明项目阶段。系统互操作取决于具体实现与测试条件。

technologies.name: AI光互连与共封装光学
technologies.tagline: 用光扩展互连，同时面对测试与封装成本

overview.text: 将光连接引入AI系统互连，并通过硅光或共封装光学缩短电连接路径，目标是缓解带宽密度与能耗压力。器件、封装和系统架构的进展需要分别看待。

assessment.text: 建议同时关注互连效率与可制造性。库内材料覆盖路线讨论、光调制器研究，以及CPO对准、测试与封装成本；这些线索表明“器件更快”还不足以证明整个AI系统更划算。 Lambda 项目提供了规模化网络部署案例，媒体补充了可换光源、维修和功耗预算的分析。Marvell 的光内存池仍处于另一条产品路线的联合开发阶段。

limitations.text: 光纤对准、连接耐久及光电联合测试可能影响规模化。APEX摘要给出特定DNN负载下的架构评价，不能等同于完整CPO产品的量产性能。

watch_next.text: 观察链路或系统级能耗是否计入光源与控制，测试成本与良率是否透明，以及动态负载下的重配置开销。 跟进不同客户部署的故障率、现场维修耗时及整网功耗对比。

scores.text: 直接面向AI互连的带宽与能耗压力，存在改变连接路径的潜力。
scores.label: 瓶颈价值

scores.text: 涉及AI互连和光电集成，但不同距离、负载及封装的可用性仍有差异。
scores.label: 影响范围

scores.text: 规模部署为封装、测试和维修协同提供了工程案例。可复制性与长期运维成本仍待更多客户数据，带动作用评为4。
scores.label: 带动作用

technologies.maturity: 网络交换有客户披露的生产部署案例。跨机架光内存共享仍在联合开发
technologies.evidence_status: 客户披露支持交换网络已部署，媒体补充了维修和功耗讨论。长期故障率与整网实测功耗在本版材料中未见。

199b013bceeb4f0168d36428.title: What Do RTL Repair Benchmarks Actually Measure?
199b013bceeb4f0168d36428.excerpt: RTL repair benchmarks should measure whether a model can fix broken RTL given a specification. To this end, we construct and hash-bind RTLRepairDataset, 5,784 (broken, fixed) training pairs; RTLRepairBench, 459 held-out cases with 374 syntactic and 85 behavioral mutations; and an evaluation harness supporting simulation and formal equivalence. We then use this infrastructure to identify two measurement confounds. First, simulation and formal scoring give opposite signs for the apparent effect of providing a specification in one evaluated cohort; reset-aware rescoring attributes almost all of the simulation-formal disagreement to reset and first-cycle comparison semantics. Second, on 274 mined model failures, the specification-only minus specification-conditioned recovery point estimate ranges from -8.5 to +18.3 percentage points across six models. Thus, a conventional repair score need not isolate whether the model used the faulty RTL. We translate these findings into evaluation controls: report initialization, reset, first-cycle, and unknown-value semantics; disclose oracle coverage and undecided cases; and include a specification-only baseline. Together, the resources and audit provide both a benchmark for behavioral repair and a protocol for diagnosing what contributes to its measured score. We release the benchmark, the training set, construction code, sanitized aggregate evidence, and reproduction materials at https://github.com/Evaaaz/RTLRepairBench.
199b013bceeb4f0168d36428.reading_takeaway: 在一组评测中，仿真和形式评分对提供规格的效果给出相反结论。对齐复位和首周期比较规则后，大部分分歧消失。

5838a15333e5c6dceecf735e.title: SGAP: A Scatter-Gather Processing-in-Memory Architecture with Fixed-Point Reconfiguration for Energy-Efficient DNNs
5838a15333e5c6dceecf735e.excerpt: Leveraging the robustness of deep neural networks (DNNs), fixed-point mixed-precision models have effectively reduced hardware costs in edge in-memory accelerators. However, existing studies on multipliers are poorly suited to mixed-precision models. On the one hand, most of them employ fixed bit-widths or offer only limited configurations, lacking the fine-grained reconfigurability required by mixed-precision models. On the other hand, layers with smaller retained bit-widths can tolerate larger multiplication errors to achieve lower hardware costs, as the inaccurate bits are discarded. However, existing approximate multipliers cannot achieve low-cost dynamic error control, resulting in this optimization potential being wasted. To address these issues, this study proposes a fixed-point approximate multiplier with fine-grained reconfigurability. By breaking full multiplication into small 2-bit/3-bit operations and discarding non-critical ones selectively, the proposed multiplier ensures high hardware utilization across varying bit-widths while enabling low-cost fine-grained error control. Building on this multiplier, a DDR5-oriented near-memory accelerator architecture is proposed, incorporating extended dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) commands and semi-SIMD scheduling schemes. Compared to state-of-the-art processing-in-memory (PIM) architectures, the proposed architecture achieves a reduction of 40.8% in area, 16.3% in power consumption, and 6.5% in latency, respectively.

631fc4bbd8b63ecee0b80d69.title: APEX: an Adaptive Photonic-Electronic Chiplet Interconnection Architecture for DNN Inference
631fc4bbd8b63ecee0b80d69.excerpt: The exponential growth of Deep Neural Network (DNN) has precipitated a crisis in inter-chiplet communication, where traditional electrical interconnects struggle to meet the bandwidth density and energy efficiency requirements of massive-scale inference. While Silicon Photonics (SiPh) inherently offers the high bandwidth density and distance-independent energy efficiency required to transcend these metallic barriers, existing optical architectures remain fundamentally constrained by static topologies and prohibitive thermal reconfiguration latencies. This rigidity renders them ill-suited for the dynamic, phase-varying traffic patterns inherent in DNN workloads. To this end, we introduce APEX, a reconfigurable photonic-electrical interconnection architecture with dynamic logical topology reconfiguration algorithm engineered to resolve these scalability barriers. Central to APEX is a novel state-aware randomized greedy heuristic algorithm, which dynamically orchestrates wavelength allocation to adapt to the phase-varying traffic patterns inherent in DNN workloads. We validate the proposed approach against an optimal Integer Linear Programming (ILP) baseline, demonstrating that our linear time heuristic achieves near-optimal fidelity with a marginal energy overhead of only 5.6% in the early stages. Furthermore, it demonstrates robust scalability to synthesize full-layer network configurations where ILP solvers face combinatorial explosion. Evaluation across representative workloads reveals that APEX delivers a substantial leap in energy efficiency, achieving 0.69 pJ/bit for the BERT model—an approximate 41% reduction compared with Simba’s 1.17 pJ/bit.

701dbfcc431daef8569f0bab.title: GTRCiM: Generic Temperature-Resilient Subthreshold-FeFET Based Compute-in-Memory
701dbfcc431daef8569f0bab.excerpt: Compute-in-memory (CiM) offers a promising solution to the hardware challenges faced in artificial intelligence (AI) and the Internet of Things (IoT), particularly in tackling the “memory wall” problem. By leveraging non-volatile memory (NVM) devices arranged in a crossbar structure, CiM efficiently accelerates multiply-accumulate (MAC) computations, which are essential for neural networks and various AI models. Emerging NVM, i.e., Ferroelectric FET (FeFET), is a particularly appealing choice for constructing ultra-low-power CiM arrays due to its CMOS compatibility, voltage-driven write/read mechanisms and high I ON /I OFF ratio. Operating FeFETs in the subthreshold region, i.e., subthreshold-FeFETs, further reduces power, but introduces vulnerability to temperature drift, leading to potential accuracy degradation. In this article, we present subthreshold-FeFET based temperature-resilient 2T-1FeFET and 2FeFET-1T CiM cell designs that address the temperature vulnerability. These two cells leverage feedback mechanisms to minimize the output current fluctuations caused by temperature drift. We further propose GTRCiM, a novel generic temperature-resilient CiM design that accommodates both our proposed CiM cells and other typical FeFET based cells while maintaining ultra-low-power consumption with subthreshold-FeFETs. By incorporating an additional column of the CiM array as a reference, and leveraging the temperature-resilient cell design, GTRCiM compensates for the effects of temperature drift, as temperature affects both arrays uniformly. We integrate the proposed GTRCiM array with typical 1FeFET-1R, and our proposed 2T-1FeFET, 2FeFET-1T cells and validate that GTRCiM enhances the temperature resilience with our proposed cells and even the temperature vulnerable 1FeFET-1R cell. Benchmarking results at system level using the NeuroSim framework show that our proposed GTRCiM array integrated with subthreshold-FeFET based 1FeFET-1R cells achieves 28.09 TOPS/W energy efficiency, surpassing existing CiM designs while maintaining sufficient temperature resilience.

8d17507365a589198532247e.title: UVMarvel: an Automated LLM-aided UVM Machine for Subsystem-level RTL Verification
8d17507365a589198532247e.excerpt: Verification presents a major bottleneck in Integrated Circuit (IC) development, consuming nearly 70% of total effort. While the Universal Verification Methodology (UVM) improves reuse through structured verification environments, constructing subsystem-level UVM testbenches and generating high-quality stimuli still require extensive manual coding, repeated EDA tool runs, and deep protocol and micro-architectural expertise. We present UVMarvel, an automated verification framework that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to build UVM testbenches for subsystem-level RTL. UVMarvel introduces an Intermediate Representation (IR) and a Bus Protocol Library to translate heterogeneous specifications into protocol-correct subsystem-level UVM testbenches, and employs a Signal Tracker and a Verilog Patching Library to guide LLM-based stimuli refinement. UVMarvel is the first framework capable of automatically constructing subsystem-level UVM testbenches across mainstream bus protocols, and it achieves an average code coverage of 95.65%, while reducing verification time from several human working days to a 4.5-hour automated execution.

9b19413eaab062e47b015aff.title: SAFTAC: Simulation-Augmented Fine-Tuning of Open-Source LLMs for Analog Circuit Design
9b19413eaab062e47b015aff.excerpt: Circuit design for analog integrated circuits (ICs) is challenging because circuit topology, device sizing, and circuit performance are tightly coupled. Existing large language model (LLM)-based methods either rely on inference-time correction around frozen models or train on limited circuit types without directly using simulation outcomes as training signals. A key bottleneck is that existing datasets do not provide sufficient task information for training LLMs on end-to-end specification-conditioned design. To fill this gap, we first construct a large-scale simulation-grounded dataset with 8,626 design tasks across 10 different types of analog circuits, where each task includes a textual description, labeled I/O ports, loading condition, target specifications, a testbench, and a reference netlist. Using this dataset, we present SAFTAC, a simulation-augmented fine-tuning framework that trains LLMs to generate and revise analog circuit design. SAFTAC combines three-stage supervised fine-tuning, which progressively builds the capabilities required for analog circuit design and feedback-guided correction, with simulation feedback-augmented reinforcement fine-tuning, which further optimizes models using simulation-grounded rewards. 9bbc7038db3f1fa234f5b94c.title: AutoC2V: Synthesis-Guided LLM Training for QoR-Optimized C++-to-Verilog Generation
9bbc7038db3f1fa234f5b94c.excerpt: High-level synthesis (HLS) can translate C/C++ kernels into register-transfer level (RTL) designs, yet generating high-quality hardware still relies heavily on manual pragma tuning and repeated synthesis evaluation. We propose AutoC2V, a C++-to-Verilog generation framework driven by real synthesis feedback that enables large language models (LLMs) to directly generate RTL with improved quality of results (QoR) from synthesizable C++ kernels. We construct training data from real synthesis results, including synthesizable C++ source code, the corresponding Verilog RTL, QoR metrics, and optimization objectives. Using this dataset, we align the model toward synthesis-aware RTL generation through Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). To reduce the high cost of repeatedly invoking real synthesis during GRPO, we design the QoR Prediction Reward Model (QoR RM), which predicts latency and resource metrics by encoding RTL into long-context semantic representations, thereby providing low-cost and continuous QoR reward signals for policy optimization. Experimental results demonstrate that AutoC2V not only substantially improves RTL functional pass rates, but also achieves superior latency and resource optimization compared to the unfine-tuned base model, representative HLS optimization approaches (HLSPilot, LLM-DSE, and AutoDSE), and advanced general-purpose commercial models (Claude Opus 4.8, GPT-5.5, Gemini 3.1 Pro, DeepSeek v4 Pro, and GLM-5.2). These results indicate that combining real synthesis data with efficient QoR reward modeling can further improve the ability of LLMs to generate high-quality RTL.

b5a2f3ff9c508e15c44ec0f5.title: 3-D NMC-HBM: Design of 3-D Near Memory Computing Architecture in High Bandwidth Memory Considering Signal/Power Integrity and Computing Performance
b5a2f3ff9c508e15c44ec0f5.excerpt: In this paper, we propose a design framework for a 3D near-memory computing architecture in high bandwidth memory (3D NMC-HBM) considering signal/power integrity (SI/PI) and computing performance. The design framework enables the physical co-design of the 3D interconnect and power distribution network (PDN) based on an electrical performance evaluation, while integrating the extracted interconnect-level parameters into a cycle-accurate simulator for a system-level performance evaluation. Each component of the 3D NMC-HBM architecture including the NMC processor die, interconnect channels, and a hierarchical 3D PDN is modeled considering the physical dimensions of the conventional graphics processing unit (GPU)-HBM module. The electrical performance of the 3D NMC-HBM architecture is analyzed using a detailed methodology considering SI for providing the extended bandwidth, and PI to ensure stable power delivery for high performance operation of the NMC processing units. Furthermore, the efficacy of the proposed framework is verified through a system-level evaluation. Integrated with a cycle-accurate GPU simulator, the computing performance and power consumption of the 3D NMC-HBM architecture is evaluated, considering the effects of reduced interconnect length, bandwidth extension, and higher core utilization. The results show that the 3D NMC-HBM architecture achieves higher computing performance and lower power consumption when computing memory-bound workloads, compared to the GPU-HBM.

f5447a6635537e0217fb4cbd.title: TopoSizing: An LLM-Aided Framework of Topology-Based Understanding and Sizing for AMS Circuits
f5447a6635537e0217fb4cbd.excerpt: Analog and mixed-signal (AMS) circuit design remains challenging due to the shortage of high-quality data and the difficulty of embedding domain knowledge into automated flows. Traditional black-box optimization achieves sampling efficiency but lacks circuit understanding, which often causes evaluations to be wasted in low-value regions of the design space. In contrast, learning-based methods embed structural knowledge but are case-specific and costly to retrain. Recent attempts with large language models (LLMs) show potential, yet they often rely on manual intervention, limiting generality and transparency. We propose TopoSizing, an end-to-end framework that performs robust circuit understanding directly from raw netlists and translates this knowledge into optimization gains. Our approach first applies graph algorithms to organize circuits into a hierarchical device–module–stage representation. LLM agents then execute an iterative hypothesis–verification–refinement loop with built-in consistency checks, producing explicit annotations. Verified insights are integrated into Bayesian optimization (BO) through LLM-guided initial sampling and stagnation-triggered trust-region updates, improving efficiency while preserving feasibility. On four real-world AMS circuits (OTA, FC-OTA, SACMP, LDO) in a 55-nm CMOS process, TopoSizing achieves 100% correctness in circuit understanding and parameter assignment. In constraint-satisfaction tasks, it delivers 1.4×–4.8× higher sample efficiency and 1.2×–3.5× faster runtime compared with strong baselines, while requiring 2–4× fewer LLM calls than prior LLM-based frameworks. Ablation studies confirm that reliable circuit understanding is essential for these gains.
